att_gene_editing_method.description: The PiggyBac (PB) transposon is a mobile genetic element that efficiently transposes between vectors and chromosomes via a 'cut and paste' mechanism. During transposition, the PB transposase recognizes transposon-specific inverted terminal repeat sequences (ITRs) located on both ends of the transposon vector and efficiently moves the contents from the original sites and integrates them into TTAA chromosomal sites
